facts.label: Licensed cannabis retail locations statewide
facts.source: Connecticut Department of Consumer Protection, 'Licensed Cannabis and Medical Marijuana Retail Locations' (dataset 42yd-3x3d)
facts.note: TRAP: the sibling dataset 4vi8-t7ex ('Medical Marijuana and Hybrid Retailers') returns only 45 rows because it excludes the 30 adult-use-only stores. Using it undercounts the market by 40 percent. Always use 42yd-3x3d.

facts.label: Hybrid retailers serving both medical patients and adult-use customers (59 percent)
facts.source: Connecticut Department of Consumer Protection, 'Licensed Cannabis and Medical Marijuana Retail Locations' (dataset 42yd-3x3d)
facts.verify: Count rows where type = 'Hybrid Retailer'. 44 of 75 = 58.7 percent.

facts.label: Adult-use-only retailers (40 percent)
facts.source: Connecticut Department of Consumer Protection, 'Licensed Cannabis and Medical Marijuana Retail Locations' (dataset 42yd-3x3d)
facts.verify: Count rows where type = 'Adult-Use Cannabis Only'. One further store is 'Medical Marijuana Only'.

facts.label: Connecticut towns containing at least one licensed retailer
facts.source: Connecticut Department of Consumer Protection, 'Licensed Cannabis and Medical Marijuana Retail Locations' (dataset 42yd-3x3d)
facts.verify: Distinct city values, title-cased. Hamden, Manchester, New Haven and Hartford lead with 4 each.

facts.label: Towns with exactly one licensed retailer (58 percent of towns with any)
facts.source: Connecticut Department of Consumer Protection, 'Licensed Cannabis and Medical Marijuana Retail Locations' (dataset 42yd-3x3d)
facts.verify: Group by city, count towns with exactly one row. 25 of 43.
facts.note: The defining commercial fact: in most Connecticut towns that have a dispensary at all, there is exactly one.

facts.label: Distinct licensed operating businesses
facts.source: Connecticut Department of Consumer Protection, 'Licensed Cannabis and Medical Marijuana Retail Locations' (dataset 42yd-3x3d)

facts.label: Operators running exactly one store (89 percent)
facts.source: Connecticut Department of Consumer Protection, 'Licensed Cannabis and Medical Marijuana Retail Locations' (dataset 42yd-3x3d)
facts.verify: Group by business, count those with one row. 58 of 65. The largest operators hold only 3 locations each: Divine 1 LLC, Willow Brook Wellness LLC and CT BGP LLC.
facts.note: Directly opposite to Texas hemp retail, where a single registration covers 249 locations. Cite the contrast, it is the sharpest comparison in the market set.

facts.label: Towns whose only retail is adult-use-only, with no hybrid store
facts.source: Connecticut Department of Consumer Protection, 'Licensed Cannabis and Medical Marijuana Retail Locations' (dataset 42yd-3x3d)
facts.verify: Towns appearing in the adult-use-only set but not the hybrid set: 24 towns have adult-use-only stores, 29 have hybrid stores, 11 have both, so 13 have adult-use-only and no hybrid.
facts.note: Medical patients in those 13 towns cannot buy locally as patients. That is a distinct, underserved search intent.

gaps: Sales and pricing: data.ct.gov datasets f382-bnu5 (Cannabis Retail Sales by Month) and ttwq-xhyz (Average Price Per Gram) report rowsUpdatedAt 2026-08-10 but return empty rows over both the JSON and CSV resource endpoints. Do not publish CT sales figures until a working source is found.
Tax rate: not yet sourced to a primary CT statute or DRS page. Do not publish a CT cannabis tax rate without one.
